source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 3 June 1939, p. 3 ("Rural council election results")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Votes from the Belfast News-Letter (3 June 1939, p. 3) and the Irish News (3 June 1939, p. 7).

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 1 June 1939. Only three divisions were contested, Stranocum, Killoquin Lower and Kirkmoyle; the results were declared on 2 June. The uncontested divisions are not named in the retrieved report. Poll date Thursday 1 June 1939 (Ballymena Observer 2 Jun 1939 p. 5; BNL 4 May 1939 p. 13); filed under 1939-06-01, renamed from 1939-05-31 (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026).
